Explanation:  
The question asks for the wife of the founder of the city where the 2023 Tour de France started. The predicted answer correctly identifies Bilbao as the starting city and Diego López V de Haro as its founder. It then names María Díaz de Haro as his wife. The ground truth answer, however, gives "Violant of Castile" as the response, who was not the wife of Diego López V de Haro but rather the wife of King Alfonso X of Castile. The predicted answer does not contain the name "Violant of Castile" at all and names a different historical figure.
